### Limitations

* This query does not measure the specific distribution of the remaining non-complete statuses (e.g., Returned, Cancelled, Processing).
* The analysis does not measure the timeframe (`created_at`) over which these items were ordered.

### Action items (proposed)

* Query the exact count of all item statuses to understand the composition of the remaining 12.5% (`SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM order_items GROUP BY status`).
* Analyze the complete item share grouped by `products.category` or `products.brand` to see if completion rates vary by product segment.
